logon.rejectedText: We could not sign you in with this email and password.
logon.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same. Type them again.

account.title: Who plays?
account.notVerified: {{ name }} is locked to other sign-ins. You are signed in with another sign-in, so you cannot play with it. Sign in with the right one, or use a link code.
account.needsLoginSignedOut: {{ name }} is locked. Sign in with one of its sign-ins to play with it.
account.codeStep1: Ask someone who can use this account to open it.
account.codeStep2: They press Edit account, then Add another sign-in. A code shows.
account.codeStep3: Press "I have a link code" here, and type the alias {{ username }} and the code.
account.startHelp: Type your name and press the button: you make a new account that is open to anyone. You can lock it later with a sign-in.
account.sameName: There is already someone called {{ name }}. Is that you?
account.sameNames: There are {{ count }} people called {{ name }}. Which one is you?
account.noneOfThem: None of them, make a new account
account.notOnList: Not on the list and have no account?
account.pressName: Press your name to play as you.
account.chooseHelp: Press your account to play. A lock means you must sign in first.
account.none: No account has this sign-in yet.
account.makeNew: Make a new account with my sign-in
account.codeHelp: Someone who can use the account makes the code: they open the account, press Edit account, then Add another sign-in. Type the alias and the code here.
account.done: Done: this sign-in can use {{ name }} now.
account.badCode: That is not a link code: it is ten letters and digits.
account.confirmDelete: Delete {{ name }} ({{ username }}) for good? This works only when the account has no jigsaws, no rounds played and no other sign-in.
account.confirmNew: Make a new account called {{ name }} with the alias {{ username }}, for your sign-in?
account.confirmNewTaken: That alias is taken, so four digits are added to it.
account.failed: That did not work: try again.
account.userActionsHelp: Edit account changes your alias, your account name and your language. Choose another account switches to somebody else: your rounds and jigsaws stay yours.
account.openWarning: This account is not verified. Anybody who knows its alias can play as it, change it or delete it. Sign in and lock it to make it yours.
account.signInLink: Log on with a verified account

verify.title: Sign-ins
verify.openNoLogin: This account is not locked. Anyone who picks it can play with it.
verify.openSignedIn: This account is not locked. Anyone who picks it can play with it. Lock it with your sign-in, and only your sign-ins can use it.
verify.protect: Lock this account with my sign-in
verify.onlyThese: This account is locked. Only these sign-ins can use it, one at a time.
verify.lockoutHint: Add a second sign-in, so you cannot lose this account.
verify.lastWarning: This is the last sign-in. The account will be open to anyone again.
verify.codeIntro: With the other sign-in, open this page and type the alias {{ username }} and this code:
verify.codeValid: It works once, for {{ minutes }} minutes.
verify.failed: That did not work: try again.

edit.usernameFree: Free: nobody else has this alias.
edit.usernameTaken: Taken: somebody else has this alias.
edit.usernameHelpEdit: {{ min }} to {{ max }} characters. Nobody else can have the same. Your rounds stay yours when you change it.
edit.pictureFailed: That file could not be used as a picture.
edit.pictureHelp: A small picture shown with your account. It is cut square and made small.
edit.languageHelp: The language the app is shown in for you, and the default language for the names and descriptions of your jigsaws.

picture.label: Picture
picture.help: Choose the picture the jigsaw is made from (jpeg, png or webp).
picture.classifying: The AI looks at the picture…
picture.saveAnalyseHelp: The picture is sent to OpenAI to set the categories, the motive difficulty, the name and the description.
picture.couldNotMake: Could not make the jigsaw. Nothing was saved: check the picture and try again.
